patterns.comment: 0 AI-flag words in 2288 words means that vocabulary looks human.

patterns.label: Rule-of-three triads
patterns.comment: 5 three-part lists (2.2/1k words). LLMs default to threes so ask your AI not to do that.

patterns.label: Signposting filler
patterns.comment: 2 filler signposts ("keep in mind") at 0.9/1k words. Cut those as they add zero information.

patterns.label: Second-person lock
patterns.comment: Locked in second person: 95 "you/your" (41.5/1k words). Relentless "you" is an AI-brief fingerprint. Vary the perspective.

patterns.comment: The text commits to its claims.

patterns.label: Em-dash rate
patterns.comment: 8 em/en dashes (3.5/1k words). Above ~3/1k starts reading as ChatGPT house style.
